body.statement: Under conditions (i)--(v) of Choi and Yuan (2024), Theorem 3.1, their common-adoption, one-date subgroup matrix-completion estimator has a group-average imputation error which, after division by the square root of their displayed variance, converges in distribution to a standard normal variable.  Their variance is the sum of a donor-loading quadratic form and a group-size-scaled pretreatment-factor quadratic form.

attestation.note: Verified verbatim against the official arXiv 2308.02364 source archive, MNAR_completion_arxiv.tex lines 388-411, downloaded 2026-09-14; this block contains conditions (i)-(v), the normalized limit, and both variance components.

body.justification: This is the published one-date benchmark to which the new complete score is reduced.
body.gap: The source treats its one-date independent-noise design; the overlap and curvature comparisons are derived in this note.
body.consumer: The published-reduction proposition uses the theorem only after proving the factor-scaling and negligible-term map.
